# What the full VOLT-FORGE would cost to build

**About ₹35 crore over 3 years, with 100.5 person-years of work.** This is an estimate, not a quote. Generated by `scripts/build_cost_model.py` from `configs/build_cost_v1.json`, where each input is marked sourced or assumed.

Scope: Everything in the final Product Vision, from a measured dataset to a full engineering application: own lab data, solvers to pack scale, higher-fidelity physics, 3D design studio, component library, simulation, failure investigation, comparison, AI copilot, reports and collaboration. India-based team over 36 months. Estimate, not a quote.

| Workstream | Vision | Person-years | Cost |
| --- | --- | ---: | ---: |
| Measured dataset and validation | Sections 7, 12 | 12.5 | ₹2.4 crore |
| Electrical and thermal solvers to pack scale | Sections 6, 13 | 10 | ₹3.4 crore |
| Electrochemistry, CFD and FEA | Section 13 extensions | 12 | ₹4.1 crore |
| 3D Design Studio and CAD exchange | Sections 4, 11 | 17 | ₹4.0 crore |
| Component library and versioned model graph | Sections 5, 13 | 9 | ₹2.0 crore |
| Simulation, results, failure search and comparison | Sections 6 to 9 | 12 | ₹2.8 crore |
| AI copilot | Section 10 | 3 | ₹0.7 crore |
| Reports, projects, collaboration and security | Sections 3, 11, 14 | 10 | ₹2.0 crore |
| Quality, documentation and support | Sections 12, 14 | 9 | ₹1.3 crore |
| Product, design and management | All | 6 | ₹2.3 crore |

| Layer | Cost |

| **Total** | **₹35.4 crore** |

## Cross-check

COCOMO II at 200 thousand lines gives 997 person-months, or 83 person-years. At the same blended rate that is ₹20.6 crore of people cost, 17% below the bottom-up figure. COCOMO counts software only, so a lower figure is expected. The line count is an assumption.

## Benchmark

AspenTech spent US$206.1 million on R&D in fiscal 2024, about ₹1,814 crore at ₹88 a dollar. This build is 2.0% of one such year. AspenTech covers far more domains, so this shows scale and is not a like-for-like price.

## Limits

Salary sources disagree widely, so the rates are stated role by role. Listings are not quotes. The person-years and line counts are engineering judgement, not measured data.
